reuse.why: Keeps using getNextDate and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but adds no shared definition of the daily-skip rule, so each site re-derives it.

duplication.why: The 'skipWeekend && frequency === daily' predicate is written inline three times (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template) and the weekend-skipping occurrence scan is implemented separately in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates with different lookahead limits.

placement.why: Part of the rule sits in shared/schedules.getNextDate, but getUpcomingDates carries its own complete daily branch in the server handler and schedule-template decides the daily case itself.

scope.why: Only the weekend-rule call sites and the frequency passthrough are touched.

maintainability.why: The rule exists as three independently coded variants (including a separate early-return loop with a magic 'count * 7 + 14' bound), so the next change to weekend handling must be repeated and can easily diverge.

disguised_duplication.where: Weekend-skip scan reshaped as find() over a take-14 slice in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate and as a manual for-loop with counters in server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates; daily predicate re-spelled in budget/schedule-template.ts.

one_place.where: The daily-skip rule is decided separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList; no shared definition.
